basics.name: Yohan Lee
basics.label: Undergraduate Researcher
basics.summary: I study the intersection of generative models and sequential decision-making, with a focus on safety. My current work centers on Flow Matching (Interspeech 2026), with growing interest in the data-centric foundations of embodied agents.

education.studyType: B.S. in Computer Science and Engineering

publications.name: Generate and Calibrate: Spectral Contrastive Flow Matching for Audio-Visual Sound Separation
publications.summary: Yohan Lee*, Sujung Oh*, Gaeun Ko, Sangmin Lee†  (*equal contribution, †corresponding author)

work.name: Pixel Lab, Korea University
highlights: Spectral Contrastive Flow Matching (SCFM): proposed contrastive objectives extending Flow Matching-based generative frameworks, improving spectral discrimination across concurrent sound sources.
Energy-Guided Calibration (EGC): designed a calibration technique addressing energy imbalance between separated sources, enhancing perceptual quality of isolated audio streams.
Co-first-authored a paper submitted to Interspeech 2026 (under review).

work.name: V-Lab, Sungkyunkwan University
highlights: DDPM-based 3D Synthesis: developed a generative pipeline combining score-based diffusion with neural rendering for automated architectural model synthesis and texturing.
Conducted empirical analysis on noise schedules and loss function design to improve visual fidelity of generated 3D assets.

work.name: AIoT Lab, Seoul National University
highlights: OOD & Robustness Benchmark: contributed to robust dataset evaluation pipelines for visual perception covariate shifts (cf. ImageNet-ES, CVPR 2024).
On-Device AI: explored model compression techniques and edge deployment on Google Coral Board, supported by the Google ExploreCSR program.

projects.name: Sign Language Interpreter in Emergency Situations
highlights: Built a real-time emergency medical communication system with a custom 70-word sign language dataset, LSTM/GRU classifiers on MediaPipe keypoints, and full-stack tablet deployment.
Awarded Grand Prize at the Ambient AI Competition, SNU GSDS.
